332: // ANCHOR: dma_impl
333: impl<D: Scalar, Chip: M, Element: M, B: Backend> HbmTensor<D, Chip, Element, B> {
334:     /// Converts to data memory tensor.
335:     #[primitive(HbmTensor::to_dm)]
336:     pub fn to_dm<Cluster: M, Slice: M, Element2: M>(
337:         &self,
338:         _dma: &mut DmaContext<{ Dma::Tensor }, B>,
339:     ) -> DmTensor<D, Chip, Cluster, Slice, Element2, B> {
340:         assert_dma_layout::<
341:             D,
342:             m![{ Chip }, { Element }],
343:             Element,
344:             m![{ Chip }, { Cluster }, { Slice }, { Element2 }],
345:             Element2,
346:         >(DM_WRITE_ALIGN_BYTES);
347:         DmTensor::from_parts(self.inner.transpose(true))
348:     }

269:     /// [`crate::backend::Backend::transpose`].
270:     #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
271:     pub(crate) fn transpose<Src: M, Dst: M>(
272:         &mut self,
273:         src: &BufStorage<D, B>,
274:         src_offset: &Index,
275:         dst_offset: &Index,
276:         src_map: &Mapping,
277:         dst_map: &Mapping,
278:         allow_broadcast: bool,
279:     ) where
280:         B: Sync,
281:     {
282:         // Structural check (also asserts `Src` is contained in `Dst`); `!allow_broadcast`
283:         // rejects a non-padding leftover.
284:         let _ = transpose_broadcast::<Src, Dst>(allow_broadcast);
285:         let src_view = &Src::to_value();
286:         let dst_view = &Dst::to_value();
287:         // Relayout: sequence the `Src` buffer (memory) against the `Dst` layout (stream)
288:         // under `Carve`. Each dst buffer position reads one Src element; a broadcast axis (in dst, not Src)
289:         // gets `memory_stride` 0, so one Src element feeds the whole broadcast run. `Carve` (not `Read`)
290:         // tolerates a `Bottom` pad in the dst stream, a `view_mut().tile()` write hole, read as a `Top`
291:         // don't-care, which the dst liveness walk then gates out of the write below.
292:         let config = &sequence(&[src_view], &[dst_view], SequencerMode::Carve)
293:             .expect("transpose: Src must be covered by the dst stream")[0];
294:         // The src window's physical base and the dst window's base. Both default to 0 for an empty
295:         // (whole-tensor) offset. The base resolves the offset against the *base* (live-axis) map, where
296:         // a tiled offset axis the view carries as padding is still a live `Symbol` (the view shares the
297:         // base's wire layout, so the wire position carries over).
298:         let src_base = window_base(src_map, src_offset);
299:         let dst_base = window_base(dst_map, dst_offset);
300:         // Walk the dst window, zipping three position-aligned streams of the dst layout: the dst elements
301:         // (each position writes its own, `dst_base + pos`), the src offset to read (`config`, splits via
302:         // seek), and the dst liveness (`iter_positions()` yields `None` for a padding / write-hole cell), so
303:         // liveness is read inline, not materialized into a mask. A live position reads `src`'s element and
304:         // writes its own dst element; the stream's trailing `Bottom`-pad positions, which would address past
305:         // the window, are clamped away below. The write is range-partitioned on the dst (each rayon job
306:         // owns a byte-aligned element range), so the scatter is safe for every width, no branch on packing.
307:         // The per-chunk position range is bounded by both stream lengths so a seek never runs past either.
308:         let stream = config.stream_size().min(dst_view.iter_positions().len());

139: pub trait GatherByteOffsets<'l, D: Scalar, Chip: M, TableAxes: M, IndexedAxis: M, IdxChip: M, B: Backend> {
140:     /// Supplies byte offsets into the table, with `Domain` inferred from the index mapping.
141:     ///
142:     /// The index chip axis must match the table's chip axis or broadcast across it.
143:     #[furiosa_opt::primitive = "GatherPlan::by_byte_offsets"]
144:     fn by_byte_offsets<Domain: M>(
145:         self,
146:         index: &'l HbmTensor<i32, IdxChip, Domain, B>,
147:     ) -> GatherPlan<'l, D, Chip, TableAxes, IndexedAxis, IndexedByteOffsets<IdxChip, Domain>, B>;
148: }

150: impl<'l, D: Scalar, Chip: M, TableAxes: M, IndexedAxis: M, IdxChip: M, B: Backend>
151:     GatherByteOffsets<'l, D, Chip, TableAxes, IndexedAxis, IdxChip, B>
152:     for GatherPlan<'l, D, Chip, TableAxes, IndexedAxis, Begin, B>
153: {
154:     #[furiosa_opt::primitive = "GatherPlan::by_byte_offsets"]
155:     fn by_byte_offsets<Domain: M>(
156:         self,
157:         index: &'l HbmTensor<i32, IdxChip, Domain, B>,
158:     ) -> GatherPlan<'l, D, Chip, TableAxes, IndexedAxis, IndexedByteOffsets<IdxChip, Domain>, B> {
159:         validate_index_chip(&IdxChip::to_value(), &Chip::to_value()).unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{error}"));
160:         let unit = IndexUnit::Bytes(indexed_axis_stride::<D>(&self.payload));
161:         let domain = IndexMapping::ByteOffsets(&Domain::to_value())
162:             .domain()
163:             .unwrap_or_else(|error| panic!("{error}"));
164:         GatherPlan {
165:             table: self.table,
166:             payload: self.payload,
167:             index: GatherIndexTensor {
168:                 tensor: index.inner.clone(),
169:                 domain,
170:                 unit,
171:             },
172:             prefix: (),
173:             _marker: PhantomData,

270:     fn materialize<Cluster: M, Slice: M, Element: M>(
271:         self,
272:         prefix: Option<usize>,
273:     ) -> DmTensor<D, Chip, Cluster, Slice, Element, B>
274:     where
275:         D: MaterializableScalar,
276:     {
277:         validate_placement::<Cluster, Slice, Element>(&self.payload, &self.index.domain);
278:         let mut output = DmTensor::from_parts(Tensor::zeroed());
279:         self.table.inner.gather::<IndexedAxis, _, _>(
280:             &mut output.inner,
281:             &self.index.tensor,
282:             &self.index.domain,
283:             &Chip::to_value(),
284:             prefix,
285:             self.index.unit,
286:         );
287:         output
